# Tate Programs

Tate Programs builds practical release-readiness tools and fixed-scope review services for JavaScript, TypeScript, GitHub Action, and MCP server launches.

## Primary Pages

- [Home](https://tateprograms.com/) - Main workbench, services, proof, and contact paths.
- [Shipcheck CLI](https://tateprograms.com/shipcheck.html) - Static release-readiness scanner for JS, TS, GitHub Action, npm, and MCP repos.
- [MCP Registry Pulse](https://tateprograms.com/mcp-registry-pulse.html) - Public aggregate snapshot of MCP Registry metadata, README, STDIO, auth, and launch-proof signals.
- [MCP Registry Pulse JSON](https://tateprograms.com/mcp-registry-pulse.json) - Machine-readable aggregate data backing the Pulse page.
- [Agent Stack Radar](https://tateprograms.com/agent-stack-radar.html) - May 2026 radar for agent-native software trends: AgentCore Payments, x402, Pay.sh, MCP, live web data, browser automation, coding agents, and machine-readable docs.
- [Agent Hackathon Submission Gate](https://tateprograms.com/agent-submission-gate.html) - Browser-only submission readiness checker for agent hackathon projects, covering demo proof, eligibility, MCP/tool surfaces, x402 payments, evals, audit logs, and judge-ready evidence.
- [Launch Proof Promo Flow](https://tateprograms.com/launch-proof-promo-flow.html) - Reusable ElevenCreative Flow blueprint for turning launch proof into short product clips, social scripts, scene prompts, captions, and a publish-safe fact gate.
- [MCP Launch Trust Ledger](https://tateprograms.com/mcp-launch-trust-2026.html) - May 2026 field note for MCP product launches: scoped credentials, audit trails, tenant boundaries, STDIO command safety, registry metadata, and buyer-facing proof.
- [x402 Launch Checklist](https://tateprograms.com/x402-launch-checklist.html) - Launch-readiness checklist for x402, Pay.sh, and agent-payment demos before real value can move.
- [Pay.sh Catalog Pulse](https://tateprograms.com/pay-sh-catalog-pulse.html) - Live Pay.sh catalog snapshot for agent-paid API provider counts, pricing surfaces, free-tier coverage, and review-priority launch controls.
- [Pay.sh Catalog Pulse JSON](https://tateprograms.com/pay-sh-catalog-pulse.json) - Machine-readable data backing the Pay.sh Catalog Pulse page.
- [Pay-Skills Launch Queue](https://tateprograms.com/pay-skills-launch-queue.html) - Current public pay-skills registry PR watchlist for x402, MPP, Solana, Base, compute, commerce, wallet, and data-api launch surfaces.
- [Pay-Skills Launch Queue JSON](https://tateprograms.com/pay-skills-launch-queue.json) - Machine-readable data backing the Pay-Skills Launch Queue page.
- [x402 Surface Check](https://tateprograms.com/x402-surface-check.html) - Browser and CLI checker for x402 manifests, OpenAPI specs, linked `discovery_url` resource catalogs, string and nested `discovery` links, manifest-level OpenAPI links, OpenAPI examples, endpoint-bearing `tools` maps, string-valued endpoint maps, direct paid endpoints, pasted 402 JSON, `schemes[]` challenge arrays, declared-price drift, cache-policy maps, accept-leg resource binding, timeout/expiry metadata, optional strict-cache findings, optional strict-proof payment-identifier and signed offer/receipt checks, credential-like public registry URL params with redacted output, contextual guide links, browser `X-PAYMENT` preflight blockers, MPP `WWW-Authenticate: Payment` headers, x402 V2 requirements headers, MCP tool-name array handling, health/status routes, HTTPS resource binding, and legacy decimal x402 v1 challenges.
- [x402 Batch Settlement Checklist](https://tateprograms.com/x402-batch-settlement-checklist.html) - May 2026 field guide for batch-settled x402 routes: escrow, signed vouchers, durable channel storage, deposit caps, claim cadence, refunds, and reconciliation evidence.
- [x402 CORS Fix](https://tateprograms.com/x402-cors-fix.html) - Field guide for browser-readable x402 402 challenges: OPTIONS preflight, actual 402 CORS, exposed payment headers, middleware order, and resource echo.
- [Cloudflare x402 Worker Starter](https://tateprograms.com/cloudflare-x402-worker.html) - Practical Worker launch guide for x402 and MPP-style payment gates: readable 402 challenges, `X-PAYMENT` preflight, no-store/private cache policy, Vary headers, and no paid-content grant before verification.
- [x402 Attack Map 2026](https://tateprograms.com/x402-attack-map-2026.html) - Practical control map for x402 and MPP launches after May 2026 attack research: finality, settlement binding, replay/idempotency, cache hygiene, discovery steering, AgentCore payment policy, and measured failure evidence.
- [x402 Metadata Filter](https://tateprograms.com/x402-metadata-filter.html) - Browser-only filter for payment metadata, prompts, resource URLs, user identifiers, query tokens, and secret-like fields before x402 or Pay.sh demos.
- [AgentCore Payment Policy Builder](https://tateprograms.com/agentcore-payment-policy.html) - Browser-only policy builder for AgentCore Payments, x402, MPP, and Pay.sh demos: Coinbase/Stripe payment connections, session caps, per-call limits, recipient allowlists, approvals, metadata boundaries, receipts, replay protection, and audit evidence.
- [Agent Payment Launch Review](https://tateprograms.com/agent-payment-launch-review.html) - Private-first paid review intake for x402, MPP, Pay.sh, Cloudflare Worker, and AgentCore Payments launches, generating a scoped spend map, cache/CORS/replay review, metadata boundary, receipt evidence, and patch order.
- [Agent Security Drill Kit](https://tateprograms.com/agent-security-drill.html) - Browser-only agent-security evidence console for prompt injection, exfiltration, tool scopes, policy actions, audit trails, A2A agent identity, Gemini-safe integration notes, and exportable review packs.
- [Agent Security Evidence Note](https://tateprograms.com/agent-security-evidence-2026.html) - Field note on why 2026 agent demos need inspectable evidence packs: policy actions, tool boundaries, A2A identity, Gemini-safe testing, audit trails, and human review gates.
- [Agent Security Sample Report](https://tateprograms.com/agent-security-sample-report.html) - Fictional sample review showing boundary map, drill results, policy gaps, audit evidence, and patch order for an agent demo.
- [MCP Launch Review](https://tateprograms.com/mcp-launch-review.html) - Fixed-scope paid MCP package and registry readiness review.
- [MCP Registry Audit](https://tateprograms.com/mcp-registry-audit.html) - Browser-only self-check for MCP registry and server metadata.
- [MCP Directory Checklist](https://tateprograms.com/mcp-directory-checklist.html) - Public checklist for MCP directory submissions.
- [Agent Commerce Gate](https://tateprograms.com/agent-commerce-gate.html) - Browser-only readiness check for x402, Pay.sh, API-payment, and agent-commerce prototypes, including price previews, enforceable spend caps, provider validation, and payment metadata filtering.
- [Agent Commerce Sample Report](https://tateprograms.com/agent-commerce-sample-report.html) - Fictional sample 48-hour readiness report showing spend map, control gaps, launch evidence, and patch order for an x402 payment-agent demo.
- [Release Readiness 2026](https://tateprograms.com/release-readiness-2026.html) - JS/npm/Action/MCP/payment-agent launch-readiness runbook.
- [Student Launch Kit](https://tateprograms.com/student-launch-kit.html) - Browser-only launch checker for student and hackathon projects.
- [Case Studies](https://tateprograms.com/case-studies.html) - Public proof of x402 launch checks, shipped tools, and launch assets.
- [Payments](https://tateprograms.com/payments.html) - Fixed-scope pricing and payment links, including student reviews, launch proof media, agent security, agent payment launch reviews, agent commerce, MCP, and repair scopes.

## Repositories And Packages

- [Shipcheck CLI npm](https://www.npmjs.com/package/shipcheck-cli) - Public npm package, runnable with `npx --yes shipcheck-cli .`.
- [Shipcheck MCP npm](https://www.npmjs.com/package/shipcheck-mcp) - Public MCP server package for running Shipcheck from MCP clients.
- [Shipcheck Action](https://github.com/TateLyman/shipcheck-action) - GitHub Action wrapper for Shipcheck.
- [Shipcheck MCP](https://github.com/TateLyman/shipcheck-mcp) - MCP server source repository.
- [Tate Programs site](https://github.com/TateLyman/tate-web-services) - Static site source.
- [x402 Cache-Safe Worker](https://github.com/TateLyman/x402-cache-safe-worker) - Cloudflare Worker starter for cache-safe x402-style payment gates with CORS, no-store/private cache policy, resource echo, and smoke tests.
- [x402 Surface Check Action](https://github.com/marketplace/actions/x402-surface-check) - GitHub Marketplace Action for running no-payment x402, MPP, Pay.sh, AgentCore-style, and HTTP 402 launch-surface checks in CI.
